_doc: Shared HTML block-structure vectors (D3 items 7 and 8): ONE contract for the two HTML parses.
Server: mddoc.html_to_tiptap (Dropbox and OneNote HTML); test_note_convert_d3.py reads this file.
Client: convert.js htmlToNote (every file importer); convert.test.js reads this file too.
Each vector: `html` in, `shape` out. A shape names each node's type and its children in parentheses; a text
run is its text in single quotes. Vectors hold no quote, backslash or mark, so both sides spell the shape alike.

vectors.name: a div inside a div splits its text
section and article are block wrappers too
a div holding a paragraph adds none; an empty div is none
a line break inside a div
